eyebrow: The real artifact of the incident
code:
NEW DATABASE ON A PROTECTED SERVER -- CHECKLIST
  [ ] Recovery model = FULL, initial full backup taken
  [ ] *** Seed to SQLDBA02, then
      ALTER AVAILABILITY GROUP BrennanAG ADD DATABASE ***
  [ ] Next AGMembershipCheck run confirms in_ag = 1
  [ ] Added to backup schedule and the dashboard
  [ ] A second person signs off before go-live
caption: The AG-join step gets a name and a checkbox -- not a memory.

eyebrow: Pre-failover check, added to the runbook
code:
Before any failover:
  Confirm SQLDBA02 reports SYNCHRONIZED / HEALTHY
  Confirm AGMembershipCheck shows in_ag = 1 for every
  database that is supposed to be protected
caption: The exact check that would have caught the gap sooner.

subtitle: The honest finish line, not an oversold one.
